data.narrative:
Aclarity is a Series A-stage climate and energy company founded by Julie Bliss Mullen that has raised $14M to date. The valuation landscape for frontier climate tech remains sparse at the early stage; the broader Climate & Energy sector includes one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers such as Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix, though none occupy the exact same stage and valuation tier as Aclarity.

The Stage-Progression method is the primary applicable triangulation approach here. Using total capital raised ($14M) as a baseline value proxy and applying a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage progression, this method implies a valuation of $28M. The Peer-Median approach is not applicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within Climate & Energy—while eight peers exist in the sector, none meet the minimum threshold of three datapoints after filtering for stage and valuation tier.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $24M (low) to $32M (high), with a median of $28M. This range reflects reliance on a single methodological input, making it sensitive to the validity of the 2.0x step-up assumption for this particular market. Key uncertainties include the appropriate stage-progression multiple for frontier climate tech (which may differ from broader VC norms) and the absence of direct peer-set validation. Further diligence on unit economics and revenue trajectory would strengthen conviction in this range.
